name: Benepass
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; New York, NY, USA
long_description:
Benepass consolidates corporate benefits onto a single card, powered by our in-house fintech payments stack. We run global benefits at scale. 

We help companies take care of their employees through tax-advantaged benefits (e.g. FSA/HSA, dependent care, commuter) and company-funded lifestyle benefits (e.g. wellness, WFH, professional development) all on a single card + mobile app.
one_liner: Pre-tax and lifestyle benefits, managed in one place.
